plan.title: Extend tests/wasm_parity.rs with WASM frame capture infrastructure
plan.body: Add native-side functions to invoke WASM rendering and capture pixel data from parity frames. Implements `capture_wasm_frame()` that spawns a minimal headless browser test runner and extracts RGBA bytes. Minimal: reads frame size from parity functions, prepares capture harness. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity --lib` compiles without errors, new module loads.

plan.title: Implement headless WASM parity frame rendering function
plan.body: Add `render_wasm_parity_frame()` to src/wasm.rs that returns RGBA bytes instead of presenting to canvas. This allows native tests to get WASM output programmatically. Exports as wasm_bindgen function callable from test infrastructure. Minimal: mirrors `present_parity_frame()` but returns `Vec<u8>` instead of Result. Acceptance: `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` succeeds, function is exported.

plan.title: Create native test helper that runs WASM tests headlessly
plan.body: Add test utility in tests/wasm_parity.rs that: runs `wasm-pack build --target web`, spawns headless Firefox with test harness, calls WASM parity functions, captures frame bytes, returns RGBA data. Wraps browser automation for CI. Minimal: uses subprocess to build and run. Acceptance: `cargo test wasm_parity -- --nocapture` shows WASM build output without errors.

plan.title: Implement programmatic WASM<->native frame comparison
plan.body: Add `compare_wasm_to_native()` test that: generates native reference frames, calls WASM rendering (via headless harness from step 3), compares RGBA bytes pixel-by-pixel, asserts zero differing pixels for light and dark modes. Minimal: reuse existing `compare_frames()` and `parity_frames()`. Acceptance: Test runs and reports differences (expect 0 for matching backends).

plan.title: Add determinism verification for WASM renders
plan.body: Ensure WASM parity frames are deterministic (same output across runs). Add test `wasm_parity_frames_are_deterministic()` that: renders twice via WASM, compares output, asserts identical bytes. Catches non-deterministic rendering. Minimal: call WASM capture twice, compare. Acceptance: Test passes, confirms rendering is stable.

plan.title: Implement diagnostic output for pixel differences
plan.body: When comparison fails, report: number of differing pixels, percentage of frame affected, sample differing regions. Add `report_frame_differences()` helper. Useful for CI logs. Minimal: format diff count and total pixels. Acceptance: Failure test case shows readable diff report.

plan.title: Add CI gate test with 0-difference assertion
plan.body: Create `full_parity_verification()` test that: generates both light and dark native frames, renders both via WASM, compares each, asserts 0 differing pixels for both. This is the single test that CI will run as the parity gate. Minimal: call compare for light and dark, assert both equal zero. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity full_parity_verification` passes and confirms 0 differing bytes.

plan.title: End-to-end local verification of parity CI gate
plan.body: Run the complete parity verification locally: build native reference frames, build WASM artifact, run headless parity rendering, execute comparison, verify 0 differences reported. Exercises full automated pipeline. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity full_parity_verification -- --nocapture` completes successfully, reports "light: 0 differing pixels, dark: 0 differing pixels".
